purpose: Freeze exactly one raw-only, output-boundary source-parity candidate for the remaining Phase101/107/109 main-FGO discrepancy after C7, raw D, QR, and raw-base parity.

scope.comparison: official fgo_gnss_imu.m and preprocessing source versus native Phase101/107/109 source and sealed aggregate metadata

phase101_structural_result.interpretation: GNSS-first and QR main have strict finite progress with complete C7/D handoff on both routes.

phase109_structural_result.interpretation: Existing raw-base and additional-frequency path passed its sealed structural gates; this freeze does not alter it.

phase21_helper_evidence.interpretation: Historical structural metadata shows the existing helper is bounded and does not change graph factors; it is not a Phase112 accuracy claim.

candidate.hypothesis: The official fixed Pixel5 phone-to-position offset, omitted from the native Phase101/107/109 public main output, accounts for a bounded 0.2--0.4 m component of the remaining error.

operation_contract.attitude: same-run optimized Pose3 Rot3::rpy(); no external or precomputed attitude

operation_contract.row_contract: No timestamp, velocity, C7, D, clock, factor, row-order, interpolation, or key changes; retain exact raw UTC-key alignment after the correction.
operation_contract.coverage_contract: Every finite expected output epoch must be corrected exactly once; unknown phone, nonfinite attitude/origin/position, out-of-Earth result, missing/duplicate/misaligned key, or fallback fails closed.

composed_recipe_invariants.ccdd_equation_units_sigma_m: unchanged; official 0.1 m CCDD remains pinned where already selected
composed_recipe_invariants.raw_base_correction: unchanged and exactly once when the existing Phase107/109 raw-base selector is composed
composed_recipe_invariants.additional_frequency_admission: unchanged; Phase109 selector/guards remain required when composed

guard_only_admission.current_source_boundary: The existing helper is implemented and fail-closed, but the strict Phase101 C7/D/QR optional-switch guard currently rejects native_upstream_position_offset.
guard_only_admission.permitted_future_change: Remove only this candidate from the exact Phase101/107/109 recipe mutual-exclusion predicate after qualification; preserve all other forbidden-switch, input-lineage, selector, finite, coverage, and fail-closed checks.
